newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS FIRMER ON HARD CURRENCIES.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS FIRMER ON HARD CURRENCIES.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar edged up during Thursday's interbank session to close firmer against most hard currencies on the back of some offloading of hard cash by one of the country's big banks.

"We had a payment going out but there was also a bit of off-loading by one of the big banks and the central bank also intervened (by injecting foreign currency into the market)," commented one exchange dealer.
But he cautioned that the recovery of the local unit, which had been losing a cent or two every day against the key U.S. dollar since the beginning of the month, was likely to be temporary.
The previous day, some dealers said there were rumours of a big payment coming up which could possibly further weaken the Zimbabwe dollar.

On Thursday however, the local currency finished stronger against the U.S. dollar at 11.1650/1750 compared to late Wednesday's 11.1750/1850 and was also quoted firmer on the mark at 6.6100/6300 from 6.6770/6890, largely tracking the U.S. dollar's gains overseas.
It strengthened to 2.4800/5000 from 2.5205/5330 against the rand but was quoted little changed against sterling at 18.2900/3100 from 18.2900/3620.
